Nothing commits the reader to a sequence; the closest thing to procedure is a five-item 'Best Practices' list of maxims. It rises above anchor 1 only because the declarative material is itself executable commands rather than background prose. An ordered 'detect state, then choose the parse mode, then emit' spine — or even a routing step in front of the catalogue — would move it up.
